svg.text: Radial 3-DOF robotic arm · vision-guided pick-and-place into a ring of bins
ISOMETRIC ENGINEERING VIEW · units ≈ cm · grid = 10 cm · orange arrows = object flow · red dashed = sensor beam · translucent = acrylic
→ Captures pad image; OpenCV finds colour + shape
→ Detects an object arriving on the pad
→ Gravity-feeds objects onto the pick pad
→ Runs OpenCV classification, sends class by USB
→ Rotates the whole arm toward the target bin
→ 2020 profile, holds camera over the pad
Closed-loop, vision-guided robotic arm: the same hardware sorts by any visual
rule you can code (colour, shape, size) with zero mechanical changes, and the
pick-and-place motion is the most “industrial” demo on the floor.
IR break-beam on the pick pad sees the object land; LED ring +
Raspberry Pi grabs a frame, HSV mask + contour shape → class
Class → bin lookup table → inverse kinematics gives base /
Arm grips, lifts, swings to the bin, releases and homes. ~4 s
